rachel: Quick plan for May 12 webinar paid support — goal: registrations + build a 14d retarget pool. Short plan: search + retarget display + LinkedIn sponsored. Soft launch May 8 09:00 PT, full roll May 12.

- Budget & pacing: $1,000/day test (~7 days). Ramp: 25% day1, 50% days2-4, 100% days5-7. Pause if CPA > $85 for 48h.
- Search: tCPA $50 for product intent set, enable DSA for long tail, brand exact +12% bid uplift.
- Retarget: 14d site visitors, two creative bundles (Invite vs ROI case), rotate creatives every 48h, frequency cap 3/day, kill bottom 25%.
- Landing pages: canonical webinar LP + lite calendar LP for social. UTM: utm_source=paid&utm_campaign=web_may12&utm_content={invite|roi}_{size}. GA4 event: webinar_register (send webinar_id).
- Routing: send paid leads to HubSpot list 'WB-May12-Paid' and webhook /integrations/hubspot/ads. If lead_score >=60 auto-create SDR task and include fields model_usecase and infra_budget. PII redaction required.

tomas_ads: +1. Will enable DSA and set brand uplift. Suggest testing a small incremental brand spend: +$150/day for first 72h to measure lift vs control. I'll upload creatives and set DCO rules.

anya_growth: LP ask: A/B hero copy test: 'Faster inference, predictable latency' vs 'Cut inference cost per request'. Also test TY flow: calendar widget vs email-only. I'll wire GA4 and tag events.

leo_design: Deliverables: static hero (1200x628, 1080x1080, 300x250) + 6s motion. Motion and static set by EOD today.

dave_ops: I'll provision mock webhook and add PII scrub rules (strip SSNs, CCs), rate limit 5req/s. Webhook URL for QA: /mocks/ads/webhook-may12.

ads-bot: Campaign draft created: https://ads.internal/redwood/campaigns/2064 (draft).

rachel: Action items: tomas -> DSA + brand test + upload; anya -> GA4 + TY variants; leo -> assets; dave -> webhook & CRM mapping. Review sync tomorrow 9am PT. Any blockers?

leo_design: Need final hero copy by 3pm so motion can match.

anya_growth: I'll post headline options in the doc in 1 hour.

rachel: Great, I'll post a short recap once assets are in. :rocket:
